title: deer-flow.bead.reenrichment_hint v1
description: Advisory emitted by Deer Flow's EnrichmentFeedbackConsumer after it records a loomie failure memo for a bead. Consumers may use it to schedule a re-enrichment pass that includes the prior failure reason.

bead_id.description: The bead whose failure memo was updated.

event_type.description: The lifecycle failure category that produced the memo entry.

reason.description: Concise, emitter-truncated explanation of the failed attempt.
